info.title: API.SH: Property24
info.description: The Property24 API from API.SH: public Property24 data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A Property24 (South Africa) estate agency: name, group (franchise), logo, physical address, coordinates, about text, areas serviced, social links, its agents (name, job title, photo, profile link), how many listings it has for sale and to rent, and its latest listings for sale and to rent (price, rooms, thumbnail). Pass `listings` (for-sale or to-rent) to also get that page of the agency's listings, each with price, size, rooms, address and photos; pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/property24-agency

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Agency id: the number at the end of a property24.com/estate-agents/<name>/<id> link. Give this or `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A property24.com estate agency link (estate-agents/<name>/<id>, or its for-sale/agency or to-rent/agency listings link).

parameters.name: listings
parameters.description: Also return a page of the agency's listings: for-sale or to-rent.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of the agency's listings (with `listings`), starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Property24 listing: title, price, property type, street address, listing date, the whole property overview (erf and floor size, rates and taxes, levies, zoning, rooms, building, parking, other features...), description, coordinates when shown, photos, the agency and its agents. A private seller's details are left out. Pass `latest=true` with search filters to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/property24-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A property24.com listing link ending in the listing number.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other filter params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. search_url), instead of `id`/`url`.

parameters.name: search_url
parameters.description: With `latest`: a search link whose first listing is opened.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Each result has id, link, title, description, price and price text, location, address, excerpt, bedrooms, bathrooms, parking, floor and erf size, agency, agent and photos. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/property24-search

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A property24.com search link (for-sale or to-rent, with any filters). Either `url` or `location` is required.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Instead of `url`: the area part of a property24.com search link, e.g. `cape-town/western-cape/432` (city) or `sea-point/cape-town/western-cape/11021` (suburb).

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: `for-sale` (default with `location`) or `to-rent`; with `url` it switches the link's own type.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Only this property type.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price in rand (monthly rent for to-rent).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum price in rand (monthly rent for to-rent).

parameters.name: bedrooms
parameters.description: At least this many bedrooms (1-5).

parameters.name: bathrooms
parameters.description: At least this many bathrooms (1-5).

parameters.name: parking
parameters.description: At least this many parking spaces (1-5).

parameters.name: furnished
parameters.description: `true`: furnished only; `false`: unfurnished only (rentals).

parameters.name: on_show
parameters.description: `true`: only properties on show.

parameters.name: auction
parameters.description: `true`: only auctions.

parameters.name: retirement
parameters.description: `true`: only retirement properties.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the listings (default: the site's own).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A South African suburb's property trends on Property24: yearly number of sales with the average asking and sale prices, monthly listings (new and total), average asking price by number of bedrooms, yearly sold sectional-title units and freehold stands with their average prices, and the age profile of buyers, sellers and owners. Prices in ZAR.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/property24-suburb-stats

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A property24.com property-trends link (e.g. https://www.property24.com/cape-town/sea-point/property-trends/11021), or pass location.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The suburb part of a Property24 search link, e.g. sea-point/cape-town/western-cape/11021, instead of url.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
